title: Derived direct image commutes with coherent coefficient scalar actions
statement: Let Lambda be any commutative condensed ring and f:X -> Y any scheme morphism, as in [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. Let bX:1 -> Lambda_X and bY:1 -> Lambda_Y be coefficient sections with bX=epsilon_f followed by f^* bY and the canonical coefficient comparison. Form multiplication by each section on internal modules, termwise on cochain complexes, on the homotopy category, and by the actual CatCenter localization on the derived category. For every derived Lambda_X-module M, Rf_* carries the descended multiplication by bX to descended multiplication by bY on Rf_* M. The module also supplies the explicit multiplication and localization constructions used in this statement.

source.place: scalarEndo_hom, scalarNatEndo, derivedCenter, map_derivedCenter, map_center_rightAdjoint, and lowerStar_derivedScalarEndo_of_eq. The scalar and localization calculations are shared in the new lower module, avoiding an import cycle.

proof.text: Move the existing tensorπ_leftUnitor_hom and leftUnitor_inv_hom proofs from Compatibility into this shared lower module, retaining their original names. Use them to compute multiplication by b using the unitors and regular-module lift. Its underlying action formula proves naturality, and the monoidal unit and multiplication identities show that mapMod carries multiplication to multiplication by epsilon followed by F(b). Restriction of scalars and scalar extension along an invertible coefficient map preserve this formula.

Construct the central map degreewise on complexes and descend first to homotopy and then by CatCenter.localization to the derived category. Prove exact-functor compatibility by precomposing with Qh, applying Localization.natTrans_ext, and using the explicit derived factorization isomorphism and its naturality. Export the equation on Qh objects, keeping the localized center body non-exposed. Name the derived scalar-unit leg explicitly and prove its computation equation to avoid repeated expansion in concrete coefficient statements.

Use the existing map_center_of_iso and map_center_rightAdjoint proofs, moved from Compatibility into this module under their original names. Apply exact-functor compatibility to inverse image of modules, using the canonical derived-to-termwise comparison. Transport the central action through the comparison isomorphism. The adjunction hom equivalence is injective; counit naturality and central naturality transpose the inverse-image scalar equation to the direct-image equation. Substitute the given coherent coefficient sections.
